Shop, then silence

A $19 buyer has no next step

From what’s public, your products sit on a shop page. Nothing walks the woman who bought an e-book from that first yes towards your assessment and your mentorship.

Your time is the filter

Every call gets the same 15 minutes

The woman ready for 12 months with you and the woman who is just curious book the same free slot. Your calendar does the qualifying, one call at a time.

No warm-up

Script 1 · “Successful everywhere”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Successful everywhere, except in love? Let’s talk about why.”

Body

“The habits that built your career, like planning, pushing and doing it all yourself, don’t always work in dating. Some of them quietly work against you. The good news is that this is learnable, and it doesn’t mean lowering your standards.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it in a free live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Script 2 · “Your standards”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Can we talk about the advice to ‘lower your standards’?”

Body

“Standards aren’t the problem. Discernment is the skill. When you know exactly what you want and how to spot it early, you stop wasting months on men who were never going to commit.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in The Partner You Deserve Masterclass. It’s free and it’s live. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “standards vs discernment” with “discernment” highlighted in gold.

“The women I coach don’t chase. They get found. Here’s the difference.”

“Chasing is swiping at midnight and hoping. Being found is knowing where to show up, how to present yourself, and who to give your time to. It’s a strategy, and it starts with one honest readiness check.”
